title: Badges
subtitle: {{count}} on record
createSubtitle: Tap the card on the reader to find its code, or type it in.

detail.label: Label
detail.restricted: Your role cannot see this field
detail.terminalNotice: This badge will not be used again. To let the person back in, issue a replacement — a new card linked to the same employee.

confirm.block: The badge stops opening the door until it is unblocked. Say why.
confirm.unblock: The badge opens the door again.
confirm.loss: Loss is final: this card will not work again, even if it turns up.
confirm.revoke: Revoking is final: this card will not work again.
confirm.replacement: The current badge is revoked and a new one is issued to the same person, in one step.

form.uidHint: Hexadecimal, 8 to 20 characters. A 4-byte MIFARE card gives 8 characters, like 830D31DD.
form.label: Label (optional)
form.reasonPlaceholder: Card left in the locker room, employee told HR
form.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters — the reason stays on the badge's permanent record.
form.normalizeNotice: Lowercase is converted to uppercase on save.
form.noCandidates: Every active employee already has a badge. Only those without one show up here, because each person has at most one active badge.

errors.employeeHasBadge: This person already has an active badge. Block or revoke it before issuing another.
errors.uidTaken: This code already belongs to an active badge.
errors.uidFormat: The code must be hexadecimal, 8 to 20 characters.
errors.validityBeforeIssue: Validity must be later than today.
errors.notReactivatable: A lost or revoked badge cannot become active again. Issue a replacement.
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
